summary: ZTO Express (Cayman) Inc. filed a Form 6-K furnishing a Hong Kong exchange announcement of the date of a board meeting. The board will meet November 17, 2026 (Beijing time) to approve unaudited third-quarter 2026 results, with publication on November 18, 2026 before HK trading hours and an earnings call at 8:30 A.M. Beijing time, plus replay and webcast details. The board comprises Meisong Lai as chairman with executive, non-executive, and independent directors. This is a routine results-calendar notice, not a special situation; watch the Q3 print for margin and volume trends.
